findings.message: The channel info at 0x98 (2 bytes) is one libwavpack refuses: it needs 1 to 7 bytes, no more channels than twice the streams, no more speakers in the mask than channels and, in its long form, at least as many channels as streams.

The channel info at 0xBD1E gives 6 channels and a mask of 0x3F, but the flags of the first audio block gave 2 channels and a mask of 0x3; libwavpack settles the channels at the first audio block and ignores this one.
